review_scope: Complete real-file fixture, before-transform, module seams and actual current importer production path. No current suite reviewed solely by name.

checks.result: Baseline transform rejects changed importer before bundling/temp-file mutation or scenarios. No current proof pass.

limitations: Current import accepts a source of any size while bounding retained newest messages and individual record bytes; preserving archive avoids treating intentional product evolution as a failure.
Journal is an explicit replacement spy, not SQLite durability validation.
Consumed bytes, grown source size and epoch are measurements; asserted success/refusal and replacement count provide the historical behavior oracle.
No source hash fence beyond literal before-transform boundaries; effective module hashes are recorded for provenance, not historical runtime reconstruction.
